Minutes of a tranquil morning, before departure
The meeting covered greeting routines and calm handling at the counter. Attendees were Julian Okafor, Jonah Muller, and Miso.

The senior coordinator reminded staff to keep communication prompt and respectful, especially when travelers arrive with companion animals that need clear guidance. Staff should review carrier labels, confirm documents, and log any service changes in the desk ledger without delay. The team also noted that Aurelia Skyways depends on steady coordination between the front desk and cabin staff so that each transfer stays orderly and reassuring for the customer.

<<FACT F040>> Staff then discussed how to greet travelers warmly, speak in short and clear sentences, and watch for signs of stress in pets and owners. If a concern appears, the senior coordinator will handle the next step and record the note in the ledger. The meeting ended with agreement to keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm, careful, and consistent throughout the shift.
